_about: FIBO 2.0 VGL template for a region or town scene (owner S7). Pick a kind, copy structured_prompt, set context to that kind's value, write every per_image field, keep every fixed field verbatim, and send only structured_prompt to the node. Rules: art/DIRECTION.md, 'Prompts: FIBO 2.0 in VGL', 'Outside the doors: the towns' and 'Real places'.
route: Comfy Cloud Bria node api_bria_fibo2_t2i; allowed only after Comfy's written confirmation (art/LICENSES.md)

node.seed: {an integer of 1 or more; record it with the render}
node.source: get_node on Comfy Cloud, 2026-11-02, recorded in baseline/v2/art-DIRECTION.md (Sizes on the Bria node). Comfy's price list does not say whether 4MP costs more, so estimate before a 4MP run (same source).

region.context: a wide illustration of one of the Hall's outposts, an open workshop where founders build, with its real Colorado landscape in view
region.use: Photon Mountain, Space Peak and Fusion Canyon. Each region's theme and view: baseline/v2/art-DIRECTION.md, The regions, until data/world.yaml lands

town.context: a wide illustration of a real Colorado town just outside the Hall's doors, where founders meet their neighbors
town.use: One real town per scene, true to that town (art/DIRECTION.md, Outside the doors)

keepers: To show a keeper, add one objects entry pasted verbatim from art/keepers/<id>.yaml objects_entry, then write its location and relationship. At most 5 objects in all (VGL guide).

structured_prompt.short_description: {the scene in one or two sentences: founders at work in the outpost, or founders and neighbors in the town square}

objects.description: {human founders of mixed ages and backgrounds in casual Colorado clothes, building or talking together}
objects.location: {where in the frame, below the calm top quarter}
objects.relationship: {the focal point of the picture, and how the other objects relate to it}

objects.description: {optional: a few dwarf or gnome Hall folk helping, in plain clothes and leather aprons}
objects.relationship: {supporting the founders, never the focal point}

structured_prompt.background_setting: {for a region: the outpost workshop and its real landscape. For a town: its real main street, square, creek or skyline, as it is, with no readable signs}

lighting.conditions: luminous golden light from a low warm sun, glowing lanterns and contained forge fire, with a soft warm underglow
lighting.direction: {where the warm key light comes from}

aesthetics.composition: wide scene at eye level built from two or three large, chunky shapes, with the founders as the focal point and a calm, bright, low-detail band across the top quarter
aesthetics.color_scheme: warm cream and honey gold with ember orange, copper and hammered bronze, gold inlaid in cool pink-grey granite, and one clear note of Colorado sky blue

photographic_characteristics.focus: sharp focus on the founders, with a painted, detailed background
photographic_characteristics.camera_angle: {eye-level, or slightly high for a town square}

structured_prompt.style_medium: stylized hand-painted high-fantasy illustration with a few bold, chunky shapes, sturdy exaggerated proportions, thick confident outlines, visible painted brush texture and soft cel shading
